objective: Run the existing synthetic-trained frozen YOLO26 initializer on all existing fixed public R2B RGB frames; this is source input-proposal measurement, not semantic visibility training or goal completion.
order: Original storage manifest 32 rows followed by original Galileo manifest 16 rows; no image-content, cue, mask, score, or GT based frame selection.
provenance_limit: The prior feasibility and smoke protocol identify the existing frozen synthetic-trained checkpoint. This lock verifies file identities; it does not recreate or independently certify historical model training.

predictor.decoded_color: OpenCV BGR input from each original RGB PNG; no crop/recenter before predict.
predictor.batching: one original frame per predict call
predictor.runtime_defaults: Use unchanged installed Ultralytics defaults for kwargs not specified in FrozenYoloFeatures.predict; runner records actual version/resolved args without tuning.
predictor.output_coordinates: All nine keypoints and box_xyxy in original native image coordinates after subtracting the added 100px border; preserve returned values, including out-of-image coordinates.
predictor.selection: selected_index = int(numpy.argmax(candidate_scores)); exact ties select the first returned candidate; selected_index=null if there are no returned candidates.
predictor.candidates: Retain every candidate returned by the unchanged Ultralytics predict call at conf=.001, in returned order. This does not mean pre-NMS raw head logits.

prohibited_selection: No cue/GT-based detection choice or nearest-reference choice.
Do not drop zero-detection, low-confidence, out-of-image, or qualitatively poor frames.
No GT/cue-derived query/box, recentering, matching, threshold selection, or model selection.
zero_detection: Save the frame with empty candidates, null selected_index, and no_detection=true. No replacement or retry selected by cue evidence.
low_confidence: All returned detections are retained at the fixed .001 call floor; no second confidence cutoff defines success or eligibility.

optional_P3_cache.shape: FrozenYoloFeatures unchanged padded P3: channel_count x 80 x 80
optional_P3_cache.rule: Save all 48 or explicitly report unavailable/budget exception; never subset by cue/model performance. Cache contains input features only; no learned head/fit.

labels.GT_admission: HOLD; this proposal pass does not admit labels or train

execution_authority: Root runs the actual frozen forward separately after binding this protocol/input lock and the runner code; this builder does not execute a model.
